english: Felt good, of course.\nMy craftsman's blood\nstirred. I accepted.
...And after all\nthat hard work,\nwhat I finally made...
Well, you know...\nI'm a wanted man\nafter all... Right?
Told him\nto go to a hat shop!
Different aims, same means!\nHat shops should\nsell them too!
Good idea!\nOld man buys us dinner!
No, he's always like that.\nNo drive, spirit or energy!\nSo no work either!
I know! Built for\nthe switch to\ndigital TV!
Shut up! No time\nfor petty cases\nlike that now!
Stop spacing out!\nWake up, Sougo!\nYou're battling too!!
Game over, then.\nTime to quit, right?\nTurn off the DS. Do homework.
Only thing you've\ngot on your hands\nis the laundry.
Come to my bar!\nI'll work that rotten\nattitude out of you!
Playing dumb, Yorozuya.\nWe say Katsura,\nwe mean Kotaro Katsura.
About that Zura\nyou claim not to know...
Could be mixed up\nin something very nasty.\n...You be careful too.
Lots to ask you, sir.\nCome to HQ with us?
Good timing.\nReport that incident\nat HQ too.
Coming all the way back?\nYou're a sly one, Yorozuya.
Shinsengumi need\nYOU to teach us police work?\nWe're finished.
Oh, Shin... Walking\non your feet? So lively...
A silver lining...\nCan we call it that?
Otose went out.\nThat earthquake earlier?\nWent to check outside.
Hit on the head.\nLet him rest a little more.
Want it? Come and take it,\nacid indigestion!
Left most here,\nso didn't lose much.
A grudge? Ridiculous!\nI haven't given anyone\na reason to hate me!
Serves you right!\n...Why do I feel sad\nsaying that...?!
Mr. Katsura warned us,\nremember? Stay out\nof Gin Tama or something.
Yes. This alone won't\ncrack the case, moxibustion!
Not sure why...\nLacks his usual spirit.\nListless, maybe?
Just as I thought!\nNo drive, no spirit,\nno energy at all!
What are you saying?!\nThis [blue]Kodokan Dojo[/color]\nwas Father's...
Harsh... But watching\nfrom here won't\ntell us much.
That's what people say.\nBut nobody seems to\nknow the truth.
Who built the tower\nand why...\nNothing officially known.

Hmph! Listen well. Those rebel apes
are a nuisance
to us Amanto. Crack down on them
harder than ever,
Shinsengumi.

Oh, I've heard
these Gin Tama
are all the rage. Fun symbolizes peace.
No investigating
Gin Tama. Understood?
Toshi, Sougo.\nAs you've heard,\na VIP's inspecting us today.
Went to the hospital.\nOvertrained my muscles.\nNow they're sore.
[blue]Hokuto Shinken[/color].\nRamen so good,\nyou forget you're dead.

Delivering an order
in this area. Then I got hungry...
Heard the ramen's famous.
Wanted to try it.
Wasted our time.\fSorry to bother you.
Hm? Those guys\nover by [blue]Health Spa[/color]...\nLet's go look...
Need good food out\nonce in a while.\nDelivering flowers?
Joi rebels aren't\na single united group.\fMany factions inside.
One yellow wire.\nCut it and we're safe.
I know. Moderates\nto extremists.\nAll kinds of groups.
The florist said so!\nSold flowers to people\ngiving out strange dolls!
Find their hideout\nbefore it's too late!\fSorry to bother you!
Worse than that!\nThese have been\nhanded out in Kabukicho!
Order Yamazaki's men\nto find the distributed\nJustaways! Immediately!
Find the hideout\nof the bomb distributors!
So they handed\nthose things out.\nWhat's the big deal?
Don't be so angry.\nDefused that huge bomb\nand returned safely, right?
Hehe... Too bad.\fJustaways are already\nall over Kabukicho.

Can't collect
them all! You weak samurai
who bow to the times
could never do it!
Obviously! That's why\nwe attacked the weak\nglasses boy for Gin Tama!
Hmph! Soon, Justaways\nwill explode\nall over town!\fThis is my victory.
No one can stop me now!\nPrepare the salute!!
Still playing with fire.\nYou never learn.
Wait. Gin Tama\ncompress Japanese\nwords, don't they?
Seppuku for breaking rules\nor die fighting\nspace pirates?
Come, Sougo!\nBeat that frog\nand make him confess!
Glad to hear you\nsay that, but...
Had a man\npatrolling near\n[blue]IKEDAYA[/color], you see.

Mysterious toys.
Nobody knows who
made them popular... You don't believe that,
do you?

A rising force
among space pirates. Smaller than Harusame,
but high-tech pirates
with cutting-edge science.
Strange Tama made\nby compressing words'\nenergy and various materials.

Words and culture
vary by planet. To compress word energy
into a weapon... The target planet's
language and culture
are essential.
Then [red]natural disasters[/color]\nstruck. The people\nwere easily conquered.
My business is done.\nI'll be going, then.

Somehow, he knew
my ties to Harusame... Threatened to expose me
unless I helped
the Banbanji.
[red]Another Daraku[/color]\nbroke the detained\nDaraku out of jail.
Ground shook,\nthen lightning\nran across the sky...
Don't know...\nBut Gin Tama seem linked\nto that [red]quake and lightning[/color].
Tch... Someone else\nquit driving\nand crashed again...
Damn...! Why does\nHIS face come to mind\nat a time like this?
Ah, that digital TV\ntower, was it...?
Someone saw lightning\nflashing toward\nthe [blue]New Tower[/color], right?
People neglect duties,\nmajor accidents follow.\nOf course.
Always listless, that man.\nProbably no different\neven in this mess.
Helping him made\nme late too! Damn it!
Had a man\npatrolling near\n[blue]IKEDAYA[/color], you see.
Knew it! Hehehe.\nLet's go redeem it\nright away!
Right, got this here.\n...Can use it, right?
Gin Tama's all the rage.\nWe don't want to miss out,\nso we're running this offer...
Remember the tip\nI gave you?\fThat shifty-eyed samurai\nnear the [blue]TV station[/color]...
...Tired of walking alone.\nTime to rejoin\nShinpachi and Kagura.
I KNOW!\nGo to [blue]Gengai's[/color].\nLeave it to me.
N-no, not at all!\nOnly did what I should!\nExcuse me!!
Oh, comrade. Not yet...\nDamn! Shameful for\nthe Fan Club Captain!
Good timing...\nHave you seen\nthat bastard Katsura?

I see...
Sightings of a Katsura
lookalike near [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color]. Not seen him? Fine.
Sorry to bother you.

I'm searching this area.
Doesn't seem
to be nearby... Tell us if you see him.
Katsura was sighted
around [blue]Saguri Bridge[/color].

Mr. Katsura's a worry.
Roams wherever
he pleases... Worried something might
happen to our leader.
Tell him to stop that.
Me too, come to think...\nBeen walking\nall day today.
So tired...\nEven tired of being tired.
